# Question

#### Course: Java Interview Questions

## Question

Find the missing number from an array of natural numbers from 1 to n. (n is the size of the array the user inputs)

```java
array = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8}
output = 7
reason = The missing number between 1 to 8 is 7
```

```java
array = {1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}
output = 2
reason = The missing number between 1 to 8 is 2
```

```java
array = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9}
output = 6
reason = The missing number between 1 to 9 is 6
```
